answer_1.quote: Evaluation metrics for Machine Translation (MT) mainly rely on comparisons with human-crafted reference sentences.

answer_2.quote: We employ BLEU, chrF++: We use BLEU and chrF++ implemented in SacreBLEU...

answer_4.quote: The datasets employ two distinct forms of annotations for human ratings, namely Direct Assessments (DA) and Multidimensional Quality Metrics (MQM). DA ratings are derived from crowd-sourced evaluations... MQM ratings are determined by experts, using a comprehensive set of error annotations and guidelines.
answer_4.guideline: using a comprehensive set of error annotations and guidelines for MQM; DA ratings on a scale from 0 to 100
